geodata_geodataflagqueue.map_data_accept: Map data accepted — repairs are locked.
geodata_geodataflagqueue.no_open_flags_r: No open flags. Run a scan to (re)check the imported data.
geodata_geodataflagqueue.showing_the_mos: Showing the {length} most severe of {flagsTotal} {statusFilter} flags — filter by category, or work the queue down and refresh.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.accept_this_f: Accept this flag as-is: the condition stays in the data, recorded as reviewed and acceptable. No rows change.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.cascade_also_: Cascade — also delete the whole subtree beneath it Without this, pruning a row that still has live children is refused.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.chain_topmost: Chain — topmost first (one slug per line)
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.children_to_g: Children to gather (one slug per line)
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.collapse_a_si: Collapse a single-child chain of same-space rows. The topmost member survives; every lower member's children move to it and the lower members are soft-deleted (recorded, revertible).
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.create_a_new_: Create a new intermediate jurisdiction under the parent — its geometry is the union of the listed children, its population their sum — then reparent the children to it.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.move_a_jurisd: Move a jurisdiction under a different parent. The move is recorded as a manual repair and can be reverted.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.replace_the_s: Replace the stored population. The prior value is recorded so the repair can be reverted.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.soft_delete_t: Soft-delete this jurisdiction. Every removed row is recorded, so the prune can be reverted.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.sum_of_live_c: Sum of live children Adds up the direct children's populations.
geodata_geodatarepairmodal.worldpop_rast: WorldPop raster total Sums the country's population raster (whole-ISO total).
